segments.title: Sea pigs hide a SECRET under their skin
segments.say: Sea pigs hide a secret under their skin: a bacterium nobody had named.

segments.title: A sea pig is a SEA CUCUMBER
segments.say: A sea pig is actually a sea cucumber. It can live six thousand meters deep.

segments.title: ONE bacterium, over 70%
segments.sub: Of the bacteria **in its body wall**
segments.say: In its body wall, one single kind of bacterium made up more than seventy percent of the bacteria scientists found.

segments.title: Its genome is TINY
segments.say: And its genome is tiny, about seven times smaller than E. coli's.

segments.title: Found by University of Tokyo
segments.say: Scientists at the University of Tokyo just described it.
Follow for Weird Animal number 25 tomorrow.
